headline: Built for small business owners who are done guessing.
subheading: Not agencies. Not startups chasing VC. Small businesses with customers to find and revenue to grow.

profiles.title: You're great at what you do, but marketing feels like guesswork
profiles.description: You've built something real, but when it comes to reaching customers, nothing seems to stick. You try things, spend money, and still feel like you're shouting into the void.

profiles.title: You've tried things that haven't worked, and don't know why
profiles.description: Maybe you've run ads, hired someone to do your socials, or redesigned your website. Some of it helped, most of it didn't. Nobody ever explained the strategy behind it.

profiles.title: You want someone who actually understands your business
profiles.description: You're not after a package or a template. You want someone who takes the time to understand what you do, who you serve, and what actually makes sense for your situation.

profiles.title: You need real strategy, not more tactics
profiles.description: You're not short on ideas, you're short on clarity. You need to know which direction to go before you start putting money and energy behind it.

not_for.headline: Who I don't work with
not_for.description: I keep my client list intentionally small so I can do my best work. I'm not the right fit for large companies with in-house marketing teams, businesses looking for a quick fix, or anyone who isn't ready to act on a strategy.

cta.headline: Sound familiar?
cta.subheading: Let's talk about where you are and where you want to get to.
